description: This source file defines an abstract base class for search-related unit tests, providing common functionality such as environment setup, response validation, and exception handling, to ensure consistent testing of different search providers within the project.

classes.name: BaseSearchTest
classes.description: Abstract base test class for search functionality across multiple providers. It enforces implementation of the provider-specific method 'get_search_provider' and includes setup and validation methods for search responses.

methods.name: str get_search_provider(self)
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to specify the search provider being tested.

methods.name: _handle_rate_limits(self)
methods.description: Fixture to handle rate limiting errors during tests, skipping tests if such errors occur.

methods.name: test_basic_search(self)
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that performs a basic search query using the specified provider and validates the response structure and cost tracking.

methods.name: test_search_response_structure(self)
methods.description: Test to verify that the search response has the correct attributes and first result fields.

methods.name: test_search_with_optional_params(self)
methods.description: Test to validate search functionality with optional parameters like max_results.
